title: Fibre CI transport under principal localization
statement: Let $R$ and $S$ be commutative rings with an $R$-algebra structure, let $q\in\operatorname{Spec}S$, and let $g\in S\setminus q$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Fix a prime $q_1\in\operatorname{Spec}(S_g)$ whose contraction to $S$ is $q$. Put $p=q\cap R$, $p_1=q_1\cap R$, $F=\kappa(p)\otimes_R S$, $F_1=\kappa(p_1)\otimes_R S_g$, $Q=\ker(F\to\kappa(q))$, and $Q_1=\ker(F_1\to\kappa(q_1))$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. If there exists $h\in F\setminus Q$ for which $F_h$ is a global complete intersection over $\kappa(p)$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field], then there exists $h_1\in F_1\setminus Q_1$ for which $(F_1)_{h_1}$ is a global complete intersection over $\kappa(p_1)$.

source.place: 00SY (3) => (2), first sentence, and 00SA for the fibre condition

proof.text: Contraction through the scalar tower gives p₁ = p. With k = κ(p), put F = k ⊗_R S and a = 1 ⊗ g. Base change identifies F₁ = k ⊗_R S_g with F_a via φ(x ⊗ s) = x ⊗ (s/1).

The canonical local-ring and residue-field isomorphisms for the localization S → S_g commute with the maps from S and k. Hence the defining residue-field maps of the canonical fibre primes commute with φ, and their kernels satisfy φ⁻¹(Q₁) = Q. For the given witness h take h₁ = φ(h); h₁ is outside Q₁.

By the universal property of inverting a and h, (F₁)_{h₁} is a k-algebra isomorphic to (F_h)_{a/1}. The latter is a global complete intersection by principal-localization stability. Transport its zero-ring clause or its polynomial-quotient presentation and Krull dimension along this algebra isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Explicit justification by C3 of 00SY (3) => (2), first replacement by S_g, using 00SA (1) for the fibre neighbourhood

theorem exists_completeIntersection_fibre_transport
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S) (g : S) (hg : g ∉ q.asIdeal)
    (q₁ : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away g))
    (hq : q₁.comap (algebraMap S (Localization.Away g)) = q)
    (hci : ∃ h : (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).Fiber S,
      h ∉ (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R S (q.comap (algebraMap R S))
        ⟨q, rfl⟩).asIdeal ∧
      IsGlobalCompleteIntersection (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).ResidueField
        (Localization.Away h)) :
    ∃ h : (q₁.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))).Fiber
          (Localization.Away g),
        h ∉ (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R (Localization.Away g)
          (q₁.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))) ⟨q₁, rfl⟩).asIdeal ∧
        IsGlobalCompleteIntersection
          (q₁.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))).ResidueField
          (Localization.Away h)
